## Context / Problem
A normal post-merge `review-plan` from the project checkout made zero LLM calls and took 512.139s before failing because `git fetch origin` hit the 300s timeout. The checkout is partial/promisor (`blob:none`) and its `origin.fetch` maps every remote head. Attested ref resolution calls `fetch_origin()` without a ref, which executes `git fetch --quiet --no-filter origin`; this can traverse/materialize the enormous tickets history while only a code SHA is needed. The failed attempt left partial packs, including one approximately 153.6 MB.

A normal retry from a temporary clone whose origin fetch refspec was main-only crossed the fetch boundary and completed the same review with signed PASS. This discriminates broad-ref transfer from model latency. It is distinct from `strained-bare-turnstone`, which addressed intermittent transport stalls and durable voting behavior, and from `grassy-cracked-morpho`, which covers completion close history-times-tracker scanning.

## Plan
- Reproduce attested resolution from a partial/promisor checkout whose origin fetch refspec includes both code and the large tickets branch.
- Change snapshot ref materialization to fetch only the requested code ref/object while preserving fail-closed attestation semantics and support for remote refs.
- Preserve blob materialization when the requested snapshot requires it without broadening the remote refspec.
- Add a regression test that records the exact fetch argv/refspec and rejects an unscoped no-filter origin fetch.
- Measure the fetch boundary before and after with a representative main-only target.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Resolving a specific attested code ref does not fetch unrelated origin heads.
- [x] Blobless/promisor checkouts can still materialize the requested snapshot when required.
- [x] Missing or unreachable requested refs continue to fail closed.
- [x] Tests pin scoped fetch arguments and cover a checkout with an unrelated large branch.
- [x] Before/after fetch duration and transferred-object evidence are recorded.
- [x] No LLM, gate, or tracker behavior is bypassed.
